scope: Loopback Node HTTP, atomic-local-json storage, two rooms and eight independent seat identities; not production D1/public Internet, eight humans, external Agent applications, or classroom capacity evidence.

environment.transport: native Node fetch -> 127.0.0.1 ephemeral HTTP server

timing.httpTiming: Monotonic wall time from fetch dispatch through full response-body receipt/JSON parsing. No sleeps or service-clock advances are included.
timing.bodyBytes: Decoded HTTP response body bytes; excludes headers/TCP/TLS framing.

limits: Loopback figures do not establish real cloud/Wi-Fi latency or classroom capacity.
No UI, draft editing, browser, physical mobile device or external LLM Agent was tested.

Expected 400/401/403/409 security/timing rejections are reported separately from unexpected failures.
